question: The highest Indian civilian award, Bharat Ratna, was instituted in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1954**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharat Ratna** is the highest civilian honour in India.
 
• Any person without distinction of** race, occupation, position, or sex is eligible for these awards.**
 
• Bharat Ratna was instituted in the year **1954.**
 
• It is not mandatory that Bharat Ratna be awarded every year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** first three recipients of Bharat Ratna are**:

 
 
• C. Rajagopalachari.
 
• Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.
 
• CV Raman.
 
 
 
• **Lal Bahadur Shastri **was the first person to be awarded Bharat Ratna posthumously.
 
• There is no written provision that Bharat Ratna should be awarded to Indian citizens only.
 
• **Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan** was the first foreigner to get Bharat Ratna.
 
• **Indira Gandhi** was the first woman to get Bharat Ratna.
 
• **Sachin Tendulkar** is the first sportsperson to get Bharat Ratna.
 
• Bharat Ratna was last awarded on 25 January 2019.
 
• The 2019 recipients of the Bharat Ratna award are:
 
 
• Nanaji Deshmukh (Posthumous).
 
• Bhupen Hazarika (Posthumous).
 
• Pranab Mukherjee.
